## Left open by the earlier read (RD-121)

An independent reader judged the previous rewrite of this lesson. Fix everything below as well. Each item is as serious as an item under "Fix these".

### Findings

1. Rule B01 (Blocker). Problem: The summary omits the purpose condition in RA 3019 Section 3(k): the disclosure or early release must benefit private interests or prejudice the public interest. It consequently describes a broader set of acts as this statutory corrupt practice.
   > Section $3(k)$: giving valuable confidential office information to unauthorized people or releasing it early.
2. Rule L27 (Major). Problem: The Section 3(k) rule lacks its private-interest or public-prejudice purpose condition. Students are told to check clause conditions in the final trap but are not taught this condition for information disclosure or early release.
   > Section $3(k)$: giving valuable confidential office information to unauthorized people or releasing it early.
